senses.zh_definition: 外来人名 Jaime；具体中文译名和读音随人物及其语言背景而定，并非已核实的马来语普通词。
senses.en_definition: A personal name, Jaime; its pronunciation and rendering depend on the individual and language concerned.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang, Jaime; sebutannya bergantung pada individu dan bahasa asal nama tersebut.
senses.nuances: 正常书写首字母大写为 Jaime。此处词性 noun 指专有名词；马来语说明为编辑释义，并非 DBP 引文。联合国人物资料中的 Jaime de Piniés 提供了明确的人名实例：[联合国人物简介](https://www.un.org/en/ga/president/bios/bio40.shtml)。以下为人名使用组合，不代表固定词汇搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Names travel through biographies and international reporting without becoming ordinary vocabulary in every language that mentions them. The United Nations records Jaime de Piniés as president of its fortieth General Assembly session in 1985. That documented example establishes Jaime as a personal name here; it does not establish the identity or pronunciation intended by this isolated corpus token. [United Nations](https://www.un.org/en/ga/president/bios/bio40.shtml)
